saints.name: St. Margaret of Hungary
saints.title: Virgin
saints.shortBlurb: A king's daughter who was vowed to God for her country's deliverance and chose the cloister over a crown…
biography: Margaret was born in 1242, daughter of King Béla IV of Hungary, who had vowed her to God during the terror of the Mongol invasion. Placed in a Dominican convent as a small child, she embraced the life fully, refusing every offer of a royal marriage her father later proposed.
In the convent on the island in the Danube that bears her name she lived in extreme humility and penance, choosing the lowliest tasks. She died in 1270, only twenty-eight years old.
saints.knownFor: Renouncing a royal marriage for the cloister.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 18 January
